extracted.name: Chocolate Frosty
extracted.description: A chocolate Frosty is super easy to make at home with chocolate milk, condensed milk, and frozen whipped topping for a creamy, chocolaty frozen treat.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®), thawed
instruction_lines: Mix chocolate milk, sweetened condensed milk, and whipped topping in a large bowl. Pour mixture into an ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions.
